name: Ancient Nutrition
description: Supplement brand specializing in holistic, paleo and keto-friendly superfood supplements — including Bone Broth Protein, Collagen Peptides, herbal supplements and probiotics — built around nutrient-dense superfoods, modern science and a stated commitment to organic regenerative farming, and associated with Dr. Josh Axe.

evidence.summary: Ancient Nutrition's official LinkedIn company post (published 2026-11-19) states: 'Over 100 creators have joined Ancient Nutrition's affiliate program since our August launch', affiliates receive a welcome kit with best-selling products and merch, 'Up to 25% commission as you grow through our tiers', brand education and a creator community, and routes applications through 'Create with Ancient Nutrition' at ancientnutrition.aspireiq.com.

The same official LinkedIn post says the brand is looking for wellness creators, moms, coaches and trainers, and adds: 'Love creating content behind the scenes? Our paid UGC program is also accepting applications on a rolling basis.'

Creator Hero's influencer affiliate roundup lists Ancient Nutrition at 15% commission per sale with free product samples, exclusive promotions, early access to launches and a 90-day cookie, seeking influencers in the paleo, keto and holistic health niches.

Katalys lists Ancient Nutrition at 15% CPS among its top collagen affiliate programs for 2026, describing high-quality superfood supplements combining ancient wisdom with modern science and a commitment to organic regenerative farming.

opportunity.title: Ancient Nutrition Affiliate Program & Paid UGC Program (Aspire)

reasons.niche_fit: Collagen, probiotics, bone broth protein and herbal supplements for gut, skin and joint health — squarely in the supplements/gut-health UGC niche.
reasons.ugc_evidence: Both an affiliate program recruiting wellness creators and a separate paid UGC program accepting rolling applications, announced on the brand's own LinkedIn page.
reasons.compensation: Published 15% base commission (Creator Hero / Katalys) rising to up to 25% through tiers per the brand's own post; no cap statement was published anywhere fetched, so cap is unknown.
reasons.contact_access: A dedicated creator application route via Aspire linked from the brand's official post, but no published partnerships email was verified.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Actively recruiting now — 'Apply now to get set up ahead of the holiday season' — plus rolling paid UGC applications.
reasons.credibility: Established category leader in natural health supplements with regenerative-farming positioning and Dr. Josh Axe association, per multiple independent listings.

name: Mito Red Light Therapy
description: Scottsdale, Arizona-based red light therapy brand selling red light therapy devices and skincare, positioned around health, wellness and performance. Its affiliate terms list its address as 9319 N 94th Way #400, Scottsdale, AZ 85258 and invite creators, bloggers and wellness professionals to promote its devices and skincare through a unique affiliate link.

evidence.summary: Mito Red Light's official Affiliate Program Terms (updated March 30, 2026) state affiliates receive a unique link, a 5% customer discount, 10% commission on device sales and 20% commission on skincare sales, with a 7-day cookie, payout 60 days after purchase, a $200 minimum and at least two completed sales, via Social Snowball or other platforms. No uncapped / no-cap statement appears in the fetched terms, so commission_cap is unknown.

The same terms state the program is intended for 'Content creators (UGC, influencers)', website owners, bloggers, email publishers and professionals such as estheticians, chiropractors and wellness practitioners, with approved channels including Instagram, YouTube and TikTok. Coupon/deal sites are excluded and routed separately via Impact.
The footer of the same official page publishes info@mitoredlight.com, phone 866-861-6486, Monday-Friday 9am-5pm MST, and the Scottsdale, AZ address.

reasons.niche_fit: Red light therapy devices for recovery, sleep-adjacent wellness and performance — core fit for the sleep/recovery/wellness-device slice.
reasons.ugc_evidence: Official terms explicitly name UGC creators and influencers as the intended participants and list TikTok, Instagram and YouTube as approved channels.
reasons.compensation: Published 10% on devices and 20% on skincare on the brand's own terms, but no uncapped statement was found and payout requires $200 and two sales, so mid-range.
reasons.contact_access: Published general email info@mitoredlight.com on the official program page plus a full program-terms/application route.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Program is live under current dated terms (March 30, 2026) and open to creators, bloggers and professionals.
reasons.credibility: Established US brand with a physical Scottsdale address, published phone hours and detailed, current program terms.

name: Crowd Cow
description: Seattle online meat and seafood delivery service founded in 2015 by Joe Heitzeberg and Ethan Lowry, connecting consumers to small farms, co-ops and independent producers of beef, pork, chicken and sustainable seafood, including Japanese A5 Wagyu.

evidence.summary: Crowd Cow's official 'Become a Crowd Cow Partner' page (search-crawled; direct open hit a 429 rate limit) says it is 'looking to partner with influencers, publishers, customers and foodies', offers 'best-in-class commissions on every order', Cow Cash for free product, bonuses, and paid promotion of partner content, using Impact tracking links, and publishes affiliates@crowdcow.com. Its FAQ asks 'Is there a maximum I can earn in commission?' but the answer text was not in the fetched material, so commission_cap is recorded as unknown, NOT uncapped.

Lasso's Crowd Cow program page (fetched in full) lists 12% commission on all sales with a 30-day cookie, in Cooking/Food categories, with application, approval in a few days, and a referral dashboard.

Crowd Cow's own press page says it connects consumers to small farms, co-ops and independent producers, was founded in 2015 in Seattle, WA, works with 100+ farms across 23 states, and offers carbon-neutral delivery.

reasons.niche_fit: Sustainably sourced meat and seafood from named farms — strong fit for cooking and food UGC.
reasons.ugc_evidence: Official partner page explicitly recruits influencers and foodies, offers product credit and says it will pay to promote partner content.
reasons.compensation: Published 12% on all sales via Lasso with a 30-day cookie; no fetched source explicitly states a cap or no-cap, so cap is unknown.
reasons.contact_access: Published affiliates email on the official partner page plus a direct sign-up route.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Partner sign-up is live on the brand's own site via Impact.
reasons.credibility: Founded 2015 in Seattle, 100+ farms across 23 states per its own press page, with named investors.

name: O Positiv
description: Los Angeles-based women's health brand founded in 2018 by siblings Brianna and Bobby Bitton, launched with FLO, the first-ever PMS gummy vitamin, and now selling science-backed supplements for vaginal, digestive, skin, menstrual and menopausal health, including MENO menopause gummies and the URO Vaginal Probiotic.

evidence.summary: O Positiv's official Affiliate Terms and Conditions (last updated May 23, 2024) state affiliates must apply 'through the appropriate social media channels (e.g., TikTok Shop) [or via our website through our Ambassador Program]', must be US residents aged 18+, and define Affiliate Content as wholly original user-generated content; commissions are based on product sales generated by that content and rates may vary by product.

BrandChamp's breakdown of the O Positiv influencer program states members earn $5 for every sale made with their discount code (followers get 10% off), rising to $10 per sale in the VIP program after selling more than five bottles a month, and states: 'With this program, there's no limit to how much money influencers can earn.'

O Positiv's official TikTok Shop Affiliate Sales Incentive Program terms (Sept–Nov 2025) require participants to be current O Positiv TikTok Shop affiliates aged 18+ and direct award claims to the O Positiv TikTok Shop team via email at affiliates.tiktokshop@opositiv.com.

O Positiv's official About page states the brand was built to redefine women's health, launching FLO PMS, the first-ever PMS gummy vitamin, followed by MENO, the first-ever menopause relief gummy, and URO Vaginal Probiotic, a best-seller in vaginal health.

opportunity.title: O Positiv Ambassador Program / TikTok Shop Affiliate

reasons.niche_fit: Women's gut, vaginal, hormonal and menopausal supplements — a core gut-health/wellness UGC niche with highly demonstrable products.
reasons.ugc_evidence: Official affiliate terms built entirely around creator UGC (original posts/videos, no generative AI without consent) plus an active TikTok Shop affiliate channel with sales incentive campaigns.
reasons.compensation: Published per-sale pay of $5, rising to $10 per sale for VIPs, with an explicit 'no limit to how much money influencers can earn' statement; no percentage rate is published (official terms say rates vary by product), so the rate is recorded as null.
reasons.contact_access: A published affiliate team email (affiliates.tiktokshop@opositiv.com) on the brand's own site plus two application routes (TikTok Shop and the website Ambassador Program).
reasons.opportunity_availability: Applications open via TikTok Shop or the website Ambassador Program for US creators 18+, per the official terms.
reasons.credibility: Founded 2018 in Los Angeles, category-defining first products (FLO PMS gummy, MENO gummy) and national brand recognition.

reasons.ugc_evidence: Official program explicitly supports promotion via blogs and social media, with a dedicated team to help with content creation and free product for placements.
reasons.compensation: Explicit 'no cap on earnings' on the brand's own page, but no published percentage rate, so this stays low per the rubric.
reasons.contact_access: Published partnerships email on the official program page plus a direct apply route — top band.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open sign-up today on the official page, subject to approval.
reasons.credibility: Founded 2015, B Corp-certified, described as the largest online seller of humanely certified meat.

evidence.summary: Hatch's official affiliate page states: '4% commission on Rest and Restore sales', a 30-day cookie window, opportunity for increased rates for high performers, and a dedicated account management team, with sign-up via its Apply Now link to Impact. The same page tells creators primarily posting affiliate links on social media they can join on ShopMy or LTK, where Hatch offers increased commission, seasonal bonus opportunities and free products for select partners, and instructs affiliates to take photos, write reviews and share authentically.

reasons.opportunity_availability: Open sign-up today via Impact, with an additional open social-creator route via ShopMy or LTK.
reasons.credibility: Well-known consumer sleep brand with a structured, network-run program and dedicated affiliate management.

Ice Barrel's Awin merchant profile states verbatim: 'We pay a 5% commission on sales with a 15-day cookie duration' and 'please feel free to reach out to our affiliate team at affiliates@icebarrel.com'. opportunity.title: Ice Barrel Affiliate and Ambassador Program

reasons.ugc_evidence: Both an ambassador program ('building deep relationships with those who serve as our ambassadors') and an affiliate program on the official Work With Us page, though no UGC-specific deliverables are published.
